description.description: Prose. Required when model is other.

membership.description: DAO-OS L5: { tree: <the id of a hats-tree System in data/systems.yaml> }, the Hats tree whose wearers are the members. Absent, and exactly one hats-tree System exists, that one is the tree. Checked by lib/rules.mjs checkGovernance.

roles.description: A map from a role id to exactly one of { members: [member ids] }, { all: true } (every person) or { hat: <hat ref> } (whoever wears that hat of the membership tree, exactly; DAO-OS L5). An empty list or null means no roles; validate:data reads the rest (lib/rules.mjs checkGovernance) because it needs data/members.yaml and data/systems.yaml.

rules.description: Per change class: who may propose and how it is decided (architecture 4.5, F2 spec 3.2). Each rule: id, applies_to, propose, decide { by, method, count | window | quorum, threshold | system, passes? } (passes: { choice: <label> }, the Snapshot choice that must win; DAO-OS L2). Cross-file checks are in lib/rules.mjs checkGovernance.

expires.description: An ISO 8601 duration (P14D, PT36H): the proposal expires that long after it was opened or last revised. Default P30D.

self_approve.description: true: the author's own approval counts under this rule. Default false, which is four eyes.

status.description: Free word. schemas/decision-status.json groups the words instances use into ratified | open | rejected | expired | withdrawn; an unknown word shows as written.

proposal.description: The proposal this decision settled (P2 writes it).

rule.description: The id of the rule it was decided under.

trunk.description: The branch decisions land on (P2-R17). Default: the branch the repository is on when the server starts. Checked by lib/rules.mjs validTrunkName.

infrastructure.description: Deprecated in 0.6: outside systems live in data/systems.yaml. Still read; validate:data warns when it holds a value.

$comment: The canonical shape (F1 spec §3.3) is this block under a top-level `governance:` key. lib/governance-read.mjs also reads a flat file and `decision_model`; a file with several YAML documents is not read. Optional fields accept null.
